$74.96 is within two standard deviations of this card's prior mean ($125.81).

Fraud Policy §3a. A case is not a report — applied here because 3a: no report. fraud is neither confirmed nor strongly suspected (probability 0.48); exposure $74.96 is at or below $1,000; the activity connects to no shared device profile, region cluster or other customer's fraud.

case.summary: The evidence shows card-not-present activity on a device marked new for this account, with an anonymous proxy connection and all unnamed match flags true. The transaction is online, the amount is unlike this card's prior near-$74.96 history, and prior closed cases for this card or customer include multiple confirmed card-not-present new-device fraud cases. At the same time, the card has prior history, the billing region is well established, and the identity match checks did not fail, so this is suspicious but not proof on its own.
